selected.title: ForgeFS
selected.tldr: Isolated, auditable workspaces for concurrent coding agents. When two agents publish over each other, the second one's work survives as a fork.

selected.title: SWFactory
selected.tldr: GitHub issues to reviewed pull requests with coding agents, Airflow, and human approval gates. The local replay needs no keys.

selected.title: What T2T changed
selected.tldr: GRCh38 against the telomere-to-telomere T2T-CHM13 reference, chromosome by chromosome: +179.6 Mb of usable sequence and where CpG-rule windows fall. Composition only; caveats published.

featured.title: Databases in the Age of AI
featured.tldr: What fifty years of database systems must become when the dominant reader of data is no longer human.

sections.sub: Field guides, demos, and measurements on agent execution. Every figure is a live page.

items.title: The Sandbox Shift
items.tldr: When isolated execution helps agent systems, and how to choose an approach, with an interactive decider.

items.title: CI Caching Is Not One Cache
items.tldr: A June 2026 POC: when native caches, BuildKit, or Incredibuild Build Cache help GitHub Actions on fresh, warm, or touched runners, with POC timings (not a controlled benchmark).

items.title: Wasted Cycles
items.tldr: Find the machine time blocking agent work: local traces and GitHub Actions latency, with a one-line installer.

items.title: Hermetic Agents
items.tldr: Deterministic demo: scripted code and test writers get the same spec but disjoint inputs; a QA arbiter with a hidden oracle blames the seeded wrong test. No language model is called.

items.title: Bazel 9 × monty
items.tldr: Building pydantic/monty with Bazel 9 and a remote cache: 121 s cold, 15.7 s fully cached.

items.title: AI Sandbox Landscape
items.tldr: A map of the execution-sandbox ecosystem.

items.title: One Lab Per Kernel
items.tldr: A technical design for running a GPU-kernel research loop (SOL-ExecBench) reproducibly on Islo sandboxes.

items.title: Rust It Up
items.tldr: Prototype: paste a public GitHub repo to get an illustrative Rust-migration scorecard. The scanner is mocked; estimates are not audited.

items.title: Inferoa Flight Recorder (unofficial demo)
items.tldr: Unofficial demo of agentic-in/inferoa: a client-side simulation of prefix caching, context compression, and routing, plus receipts from real vLLM runs in islo.dev sandboxes.

items.title: Agentic Airbyte
items.tldr: Design for agent-driven ETL, plus one verified run: 50,000 rows from ClickHouse to DuckDB in an islo.dev sandbox. Not affiliated with Airbyte.

items.title: Evals or You're Blind
items.tldr: Runnable demo after Joshua Görner's PyCon DE 2026 talk: Pydantic Evals grade a Pydantic AI build-triage agent offline, live, or on a disposable crabbox box.

items.title: Repo2RLEnv × Crabbox
items.tldr: Demo record: scoring Repo2RLEnv pr_diff tasks on an islo.dev sandbox via crabbox, about 50 s per task.

items.title: Odysseus × Crabbox
items.tldr: Demo: run odysseus-dev's Odysseus AI workspace, and its agent's code, on throwaway islo.dev microVMs via openclaw/crabbox, from a fork's one-file crabbox.sh.

items.title: Tiny Long-Memory Benchmark (toy demo)
items.tldr: A LongMemEval-style toy benchmark fanned out across sandboxes.

items.title: Meta-harness on Islo
items.tldr: A deterministic simulation of harness optimization: scripted agent, pattern-matching proposer, five toy tasks.

items.title: env-rosetta
items.tldr: Demo: @adithya-s-k's Wordle env from RL_Envs_101 in four RL frameworks (OpenEnv, ORS, NeMo Gym, Verifiers); two ran in islo.dev sandboxes, and the sample rollouts are scripted.

items.title: Crabbox Runner for RustRover
items.tldr: MVP plugin: run cargo test and clippy from RustRover through the OpenClaw Crabbox CLI on remote Crabbox runners or Islo sandboxes.

items.title: Gemma System One
items.tldr: Research prototype: Gemma 3 4B as a one-forward-pass decision function in native Rust, with shared-state inference across many questions.

items.title: Pokeloop
items.tldr: Demo: a genetic-algorithm loop over LLM system prompts, designed to fan out across parallel islo.dev sandboxes, with a Pokémon Crystal-style viewer. Results are a scripted playback; no agent was trained.

items.title: unity-loop
items.tldr: Proof of concept: Claude proposes and scores CSS variants around one fixed Unity WebGL scene (Lightning VFX by @MirzaBeig), each served from its own islo.dev sandbox. Scores shown come from a deterministic offline demo.

items.title: wolfram-fb0
items.tldr: Can a 1B local model write x86-64 assembly for Rule 30 inside a VM? First 3 iterations: not yet.

sections.sub: Computational genomics, open physics, and evidence-aware compute.

items.title: Reference Broadcast by VM Snapshot
items.tldr: Demo on islo.dev: warm one sandbox with the GRCh38 reference, snapshot it, then fork it copy-on-write per chromosome for genomic scatter-gather.

items.title: Open Physics Problems
items.tldr: 112 open physics problems mapped like open mathematics: publication cultures, refutability, and ten-day agentic sprints.

items.title: Evidence-Aware MapReduce
items.tldr: Fork workers freely while keeping evidence, uncertainty, and shared origins visible, so a repeated error is not counted as consensus. Preprint, 2026.

sections.sub: Longer reads and field reports on how software is being rearranged.

items.title: The Stochastic CPU
items.tldr: A field report on the cloud being rebuilt for agents: the agent hour, two-layer caches, snapshot provenance.

items.title: From Microservices to Microcells
items.tldr: A plain explanation of microcells: tasks that run when needed, save progress, and survive a crash, plus a safe migration path.

items.title: Free* Intelligence
items.tldr: A field report on the difference between a fluent model answer and an accountable agent harness.

items.title: The Living Layer
items.tldr: A speculative architecture thesis: sandboxed execution plus governed, queryable state.

items.title: The Data That Taught the Machines
items.tldr: How Stack Overflow trained its own replacement.

items.title: The Loop Is Coming Apart
items.tldr: jj, Crabbox, and the unbundled development cycle: the diff is the unit of work.

items.title: Intel: Vision Without Execution
items.tldr: An opinion essay in comic style on Intel's bets and misses, 2000–2026.

items.title: Your Agent Escaped Without Escaping the Sandbox
items.tldr: Four doors an agent can walk out through without breaking the wall: the key, the folder, the wire, the verdict. Zenity AI Agent Security Summit, New York, October 2026.

items.title: A Sandbox Provider for Apache Airflow
items.tldr: One ephemeral microVM per Airflow task try, for fast fan-out and controlled untrusted execution. Airflow Town Hall, July 2026.

items.title: A Million Compiles. One Robot Hour.
items.tldr: Rust China Conf talk page in English (中文 version linked): a simulated robot, a stale-observation bug, the Rust fix, and the Incredibuild rebuild loop, with recorded evidence.

items.title: How Market Making Works
items.tldr: 13 in-browser simulations, from the limit order book to Avellaneda–Stoikov, Glosten–Milgrom, and Kyle's λ.

items.title: Avellaneda–Stoikov, in a Sandbox
items.tldr: A synthetic reproduction of the Avellaneda–Stoikov vs symmetric market-maker comparison from Sasson, Ho & Samson (Stanford MSE448, 2018), run in an Islo sandbox in about 90 seconds with no local Python. The qualitative result reproduces; the dollar magnitudes do not.
